cards.name: Son Goku and Vegeta
cards.skill:
[Activate: Main] [Once per turn] Choose 1 red <Son Goku: Br> card or red <Vegeta: Br> card from your hand and place it in your Drop Area: Draw 2 cards, then choose up to 1 card in your life and add it to your hand.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less: You may draw 1 card, then choose up to 1 of your energy, switch it to Active Mode, and flip this card over.
cards.backSkill:
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card.
[Activate: Battle][Once per turn] Choose 1 red card from your hand and place it in your Drop Area: If there are 2 or more red <Son Goku: Br> cards and 2 or more red <Vegeta: Br> cards in your Drop Area, and it's your turn, your opponent can't activate [Counter] skills with energy costs of 2 or more for the duration of the turn, and this card gets +5000 power and [Double Strike] for the duration of the turn.
